reasons: Aggregation differs: Datadog sum:redis.net.slaves sums across series, but the candidate uses avg(), which divides by the series count and gives a different value.
The Datadog host template variable (prefix host, default *) should become a host=~"$host" matcher, but the candidate omits it, so the series set is not filtered as the request specifies.
Quantity and unit match: redis.slaves.connected (non-monotonic sum, {replica}) measures the same connected-replica count as redis.net.slaves, and no rate() is needed.
The scope variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct. The unused key variable has no effect on the query.
Outcome translated is correct, since no Datadog function is involved. The host label name should be confirmed against the dataset, because dataset_labels does not list it.
